grant.note: D-face (Web) recon: attribution of the allow and deny lanes on one governed Member, against a controlled local endpoint. No candidate claim, no cumulative cap, at most 2 concurrent dev Hosts for this lane (machine-wide cap raised to 6 by the 2026-11-13 ruling).
